description: The bar chart illustrates the distribution of Pass@1 accuracy scores for the Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct model on the MATH-500 benchmark, segmented into five equally spaced bins along the horizontal axis ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, with bin boundaries at 0.0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, and 1.0. The vertical axis represents the percentage of instances falling within each bin, scaled from 0.0 to 0.8 in increments of 0.1. Five light blue bars correspond to each bin: the first (0.0–0.2) reaches 11.2%, the second (0.2–0.4) and third (0.4–0.6) both reach 3.4%, the fourth (0.6–0.8) reaches 5.8%, and the fifth (0.8–1.0) dominates at 76.2%. A red dashed vertical line at 0.82 marks the mean Pass@1 score, with the label “mean: 0.82” displayed in red near the top of the chart. The chart visually emphasizes that the vast majority of test instances achieve high accuracy, with nearly three-quarters scoring above 0.8, while only a small fraction fall below 0.6.
